node.statement: LEGACY F2 SUMMIT, scope-corrected after Round 17: for the Frobenius tower's moving sectors, the Gaussian-period-norm census deviation obeys a max-to-mean bound within tolerance 2^{1.05e12}. This remains a meaningful growing-order Myerson/Q target on sectors where its hypotheses apply, but the tower is not the official admissible-row decomposition and (O1) is false on non-generating admissible rows. It is therefore evidence for, not the sole requirement of, the repaired all-row F2 close.
